name: 48315 · Shelby Twp, MI
findings: ZIP 48315 (Shelby Twp) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48315 (Shelby Twp) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48315 (Shelby Twp) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
